$comment: How free-for-all and team fights play (docs/GAME_MODES.md, "Spawns, protection and awards"; sim/spawns.ts, sim/awards.ts). `spawnProtection`: seconds of spawn protection by mode (a shield nobody else's damage gets through, dropped the moment you fire, throw or strike; modes not listed have none). `botFireBefore`: a bot under spawn protection holds its fire (gets its bearings) until this many seconds before its shield runs out, unless an unshielded enemy is right on top of it: more seconds, more firing earlier and more spawn deaths; fewer, the reverse. `spawnChoice`: how a spawn point is chosen, the same for people and bots: every candidate is scored (distance to the nearest enemy up to `enemyRange` m, and past `farRange` m `farWeight` a metre off, so a spawn is safe but not out of the game; each of the `sightEnemies` nearest enemies within `sightRange` m with a clear line to it costs `seenPenalty`, checked for the best `sightCandidates`; each death within `deathRadius` m in the last `deathSeconds` costs up to `deathPenalty`, less with distance and time; team modes: each living teammate out of a fight within `mateRange` m adds `mateBonus`, up to `mateMax`, and on shared spawns a side keeps its own part of the map: `sideWeight` a metre nearer the side's own spawns than the enemy's, at most `sideMax` either way), then one is picked at random among the best `safeFew` within `margin` of the best. `heavyHit`: damage in one hit that counts as a heavy hit (the big-hit effect, the screen edge). `awards`: the end-of-match awards' thresholds (most accurate needs `accuracyMinShots` rounds fired; the longest streak at least `streakMin` kills; a nemesis at least `nemesisMin` kills of one player; most revenge kills at least `revengeMin`). `callouts`: `nemesis` kills of you in a row, with none back, make that player your nemesis (the callout). Edit, then run `node tools/content/match-play.mjs`.
